method: a genuine Avito item page of a private listing rendered in the operator's Chrome over raw CDP on 2026-11-06 10:08 MSK (page.content() via avito_card's own fetch); trimmed to the schema.org Product offer, the safe-deal widget (data-marker=safedeal-item-card; captured element nesting and text, Avito's generated attributes, icons and scripts stripped) and window.__staticRouterHydrationData reduced to the buyerItem keys item_state.py reads (item.isActive, item.deliveryInfo.isReserved, safeDealDesktop.reserved), each copied from the capture; trimming removed keys and added none. De-identified: listing id, URL, title, description and photos are fictional; no seller name, id, phone, profile link or contacts block is kept; a fresh capture of the same listing at 13:50 MSK (review round 2) carries every kept key with the same value

ground_truth.note: availability active: item.isActive=true, item.deliveryInfo.isReserved=false and safeDealDesktop.reserved=false; the safe-deal widget offers delivery, no reservation banner
